verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's Storefront theme documents a real templating/hook layer (add_action() functions for inserting HTML/PHP/JS into core templates), giving developers a documented customization surface, and WC-CLI/REST APIs support scripted, code-based workflows. However, there is no evidence of a documented local preview tool (e.g., theme dev server, local site tooling) or any first-party guidance for version-controlled theme deploys (git-based workflows, staging/production promotion). missing for 10: local preview tooling, documented version-controlled deploy workflow, end-to-end theme dev lifecycle guide.
